benefits.ja: 機長の口コミ2件とも保険に不満を示している。現職の機長は「医療保険はほとんど冗談のようだ」と書き、香港の生活費に比べ待遇が足りないこと、子どもの学費補助が無いこと、3年に限られた契約も挙げる。元機長も「乏しい健康保険」を欠点とし、報酬水準は妥当だとしている。
benefits.en: Both captain reviews are unhappy with medical cover. A current captain writes that the medical insurance is almost a joke and says the overall package falls short of Hong Kong's cost of living, with no school-fee support and contracts limited to three years. A former captain also lists "poor health insurance" as a downside while calling the pay level reasonable.
